devices.name: Abbott pacemaker
devices.pathway: pma (P880086 — the ex-Pacesetter/St. Jude pacemaker PMA, DXY/NVZ supplement stream 1989-2025: Accent/Assurity/Endurity/Zephyr generators — plus P140033, the LWP Assurity/Endurity MRI line 2017-2025). RE-KEY: the flagged LWP/NVZ 'two-code fusion' is BENIGN — LWP, NVZ and DXY are all pacemaker pulse-generator codes across PMA generations, one device type. The REAL contamination is the ZEPHYR pattern pulling in the PULMONX Zephyr endobronchial valve (P180002, code NJK): 1,633 MAUDE reports (3.9% of family) and 151 of the Zephyr brand's 372 death reports (41%) are a lung valve, not a pacemaker; plus 20 cochlear-implant (MCM) reports. The computed record's 23 '510(k) approvals' are ALL namesake noise (Accent hearing aid, Cook Accent catheters, Zephyr respirator/transfer sled) — the pacemaker family has zero 510(k) rows. Key on P880086+P140033; brands ASSURITY/ENDURITY/ACCENT, ZEPHYR only with a St. Jude/Abbott firm filter. Corrected all-time MAUDE deaths ~1,149 (Assurity 489, Accent 394, Zephyr-pacer 221, Endurity 45). The computed record's '130 nonconforming recalls' evidence is ALSO fusion junk: zero of the nonconforming recalls on these codes are St. Jude/Abbott (Boston Scientific 8, Medtronic 2 — the magnet/reed-switch sample is another firm's device).

devices.name: Durata / Riata ICD leads
devices.pathway: pma (P950022 — the St. Jude/Abbott high-voltage ICD-lead PMA: Riata 2002-2011, Durata 2008-2026, Optisure 2014-2026 supplement streams; zero 510(k) rows). RE-KEY: the brand family fused ENDOTAK — a BOSTON SCIENTIFIC lead under P910073 — into an Abbott-labeled score: ~47.7k of the 123.7k fused MAUDE reports (38.5%) and 486 death reports belong to a competitor's product. The NVY/LWS 'two-code' flag is leads (NVY) vs generator-coded lead events (LWS) — same tort family — but the cross-manufacturer contamination is real. Key on brands DURATA/RIATA/OPTISURE + P950022 only. Corrected all-time MAUDE death reports: Durata 1,700 / Riata 677 / Optisure 289 (brand-overlap dedup pending).
